name: Focus Lens Image
description: A blurred hero image with a sharp lens that follows the cursor. Pass any image as src: outside the lens it stays soft, inside it comes into focus, perfectly aligned. Plain React, no dependencies.

props.name: src
props.description: The image: any URL or path. It covers the component (object-fit: cover).

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur outside the lens, in px.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How far the lens trails the pointer, from 0 (glued to it) to 0.97 (slow and floaty).

props.name: frameColor
props.description: Colour of the lens frame and crosshair. 'transparent' hides the frame.

props.name: crosshair
props.description: A small + in the middle of the lens.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
